text:
maria_sales: Heads-up from ACME POC — they reported their sandbox credits dropped from 10k to ~6k in ~2 hours. They were running a small streaming chat demo.
sam_support: ugh. do we have their account id? any error logs from the client side?
maria_sales: account id  acct-ACME-99. They shared this screenshot: 'usage page shows 4k tokens in 1h' and they're seeing many small requests.
jordan_eng: tagging in — streaming counts can be tricky. are they using chunked streaming or calling complete generation per message?
nate_se: @jordan_eng they said they used the JS SDK stream API with onProgress -> sending each partial to server for analytics. could double count if they echo partials as new requests.
jordan_eng: exact. streaming consumes tokens as you stream response tokens back to our API; if they then make followup calls for each partial, that's extra. ask for a snippet of their client loop.
maria_sales: sent this snippet from them:
```js
// client pseudo
const s = model.stream({prompt})
s.on('data', chunk => { socket.emit('message', chunk.text) })
// later they call model.generate({prompt: chunk.text})
```
sam_support: that second call would generate additional tokens per partial. also check retry storms — our SDK had a bug in older versions that retried streaming in overlapping windows if the socket reconnected.
ops_bot: billing-alert acct-ACME-99: free_credit_threshold=5000 crossed; notify=team-sales,billing.
lee_billing: I see several free-credit consumption events around 2026-03-20T14:02:12Z that line up with streaming sessions. Events show both 'generation' and 'stream_chunk' meter entries.
jordan_eng: can you paste the meter log lines?
lee_billing: sure:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z acct-ACME-99 meter generation tokens=1200 model=rw-v1
2026-03-20T14:02:13Z acct-ACME-99 meter stream_chunk tokens=800 model=rw-v1
2026-03-20T14:03:05Z acct-ACME-99 meter generation tokens=950 model=rw-v1
```

sam_support: that pattern (generate + stream_chunk) suggests the client both requested completions and also accepted stream chunks as separate billable events. we should confirm if their SDK version is latest.
nate_se: they said they're on 0.9.2 — there's an open fix in 0.9.3 that dedups stream chunk events for sandbox accounts.
maria_sales: client asked if this is a bug or expected behavior — they quoted the free credits and want a make-good if it's a bug.
lee_billing: policy: if it's a confirmed Redwood-side metering bug we can credit back. need root cause. I'll mark provisional credit pending root cause.
jordan_eng: I can repro locally. creating a small harness to mimic their flow. will post logs in thread.
jordan_eng: repro steps:
```
1) use SDK 0.9.2 stream API
2) on each 'data' event call generate with the partial text
3) observe two meter events per interaction
```

jordan_eng: repro confirmed, two events per partial. filed ticket INF-1284 and linked to Sandbox metering.
sam_support: thanks. action items: 1) ask client to update to 0.9.3 patch (temporary mitigation), 2) lee to hold credits while we confirm, 3) eng to triage INF-1284 for a fast fix + backfill correction job.
maria_sales: client pushed back — they want rollback/credit ASAP so POC can continue. can we offer an interim credit to make them whole for the overage?
lee_billing: I'll provision a manual credit for 4k tokens and mark as 'pending-debit-reversal' until we have final RCA.
ate_se: also worth noting they hit a rate limit spike and retried ~20x for a short window — that worsened burn. can SRE check if a bad client loop caused retries?
jordan_eng: looking at request logs: repeated 429 followed by immediate retries in their client code. sample:
```
[2026-03-20T14:02:10Z] req id=R1 status=429
[2026-03-20T14:02:10Z] req id=R2 status=200
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] req id=R3 status=429
// client retries without exponential backoff
```
sam_support: i'll send them safe patch (0.9.3) plus recommended backoff code and ask for logs after upgrade.
maria_sales: client ok with temporary credit and wants to move forward if we guarantee this won't recur.
lee_billing: credit issued, I DM'd finance. note: we'll reconcile after INF-1284 fix.
ops_bot: ticket INF-1284 created and linked to acct-ACME-99.
jordan_eng: plan: hotfix SDK to dedupe stream chunk events + dedupe at metering layer; backfill job to refund duplicate events for sandbox and trial accounts. ETA 48h for hotfix, 5d for backfill.
maria_sales: perfect — pls ping me when hotfix rolling so I can update ACME.
sam_support: I'll coordinate release notes and a short how-to for customers to avoid the issue in the interim.
lee_billing: closing loop: provisional credit posted, final amount pending backfill.
maria_sales: thanks team. ACME is sensitive to billing surprises — let's prioritize comms. :thumbsup:
